title: GET /api/v1/authenticated/api_keys, 200
description: ApiKeysController#index, api_keys_controller.rb lines 5-13: the user's first API key, created on the spot when the user has none. Hackatime's keys are the UUIDv4 strings wakatime-cli sends (HC 1.2), but the schema doesn't pin the format, because pairtime answers this call with a read-only ptr_ token instead (DESIGN 5.10).

token.description: Stardance reads only this field (stardance hackatime_service.rb line 183) and then sends it as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
